grounding.proposition: Permit footnote *1 is defined as 'When discharging.' and is the authoritative text behind DMR_COMMENT_TEXT 'WHEN DISCHARGING.'
Effluent limit monitoring frequencies for intermittent-flow Outfall 001 are marked with footnote (*1), tying scheduled monitoring to the discharge condition.
When there is no discharge during the sampling month, the permittee must mark the NO DISCHARGE box on the DMR instead of performing parameter monitoring for that month.
The statement of basis paraphrases the same discharge-conditioned monitoring schedule (flow daily, TRC daily, pH weekly, TDS and cyanide quarterly) using explicit 'when discharging' language.

interpretation: Monitoring frequencies and associated effluent-limit compliance obligations apply only during periods when the permittee is actually discharging; no-discharge periods require no parameter monitoring and instead use NO DISCHARGE DMR reporting.
remaining_uncertainty: Whether discharge actually occurred during any specific FY2025 monitoring period is not established from structured DMR data (140 FY2025 measurement rows for these limit_value_ids have blank NODI_CODE and numeric DMR_VALUE_NMBR). Resolution is grounded in the NM0028762 aztec permit package and may not generalize to other permits.
